countdown.noTime: No sunrise time in your calendar for today

calendar.welcomeText: Import the calendar file (zmanimData.json) once. The app keeps it and shows today's visible sunrise every day.
calendar.privacy: The file stays on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.
calendar.removeConfirm: Remove the calendar from this phone?
calendar.expiresSoon: Your calendar ends in {days} days. Import the new one when you get it.
calendar.expired: Your calendar has ended. Import the new one.

errors.invalidJson: This file is not a valid JSON file.
errors.invalidFormat: This file is not a calendar file.
errors.noSunrise: No visible sunrise times were found in this file.
errors.isStepsFile: This is a list of prayer steps. Import it in Settings, Prayer steps.
errors.unknown: The file could not be read.

steps.title: Prayer steps
steps.sectionHint: Optional. Add times such as Kaddish 21 min before sunrise. The countdown goes through them one by one.
steps.listNameHint: Shown when you share the list
steps.empty: No steps yet. The countdown shows sunrise only.
steps.sunriseLocked: Reference time. It can be renamed, not deleted.
steps.noPreview: No sunrise in the calendar for this day, so clock times cannot be shown.
steps.copied: List copied. Paste it in a message.
steps.label: Name
steps.pasteHint: One step per line: a name and the minutes before sunrise, for example “Kaddish -21”, “Hodu, -17:30” or “Yishtabach 6”. Without a sign the time is before sunrise. Use + or “after” for times after sunrise. Two columns copied from a spreadsheet also work.
steps.modeMergeHint: Same names are updated, others are added. Nothing is removed.
steps.ignoredLines: 1 line with errors will be ignored | {count} lines with errors will be ignored

errors.labelDuplicate: Another step already has this name
errors.offsetRange: Must be between {min} min before and {max} min after sunrise
errors.offsetZero: 0 is sunrise. Rename the sunrise step instead.
errors.conflictSign: Both “+” and “before” (or “-” and “after”) on this line
errors.invalidJson: This file is not a valid JSON file.
errors.notStepsFile: This file is not a list of prayer steps.
errors.isCalendarFile: This is a calendar file. Import it in Settings, Calendar.
errors.newerVersion: This list was made with a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again.
errors.unknown: The file could not be read.

install.title: Add to Home Screen
install.subtitle: Open the app from its own icon. It works offline, and your calendar is kept for good.
install.storageWarning: In the browser, your calendar can be deleted after a few days without a visit. Add the app to your Home Screen so it stays.
install.afterInstall: Then open the app from the new icon and import your calendar there. The browser and the Home Screen app do not share their data.

android.title: Android
android.step3: Choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.

sleep.warning: Sunrise has passed. The screen turns off in {seconds} s. Touch the screen to keep it on.
sleep.wake: Touch to turn the screen back on

settings.title: Settings
settings.blackBackgroundHint: Only the number changes color. Uses less battery.
settings.hideFarDigits: Hide the number while sunrise is far
settings.hideFarDigitsHint: Shows a grey __:__ until 2 hours before sunrise.
settings.farRefreshHint: In the last minutes before sunrise it updates at least every 5 seconds, and every second in the last 20 seconds.
settings.keepAwakeHint: The phone does not lock while the countdown is open.
settings.keepAwakeUnsupported: Not supported on this device. Update iOS or set Auto-Lock manually.
settings.autoSleep: Turn the screen off after sunrise
settings.autoSleepHint: Right after sunrise, unless you touch the screen, it goes black and the phone can lock.
settings.brightnessTip: Tip: a web app cannot change the screen brightness. Lowering it in Control Center saves the most battery.
settings.dimWhenIdleHint: After 10 seconds without touch the screen gets darker. Touch to brighten. Never dimmed in the last minute.
